# Professional Resource Library

> Professional Resource Library is an educational publication that keeps regulated-service topics separate: legal, medical, immigration, dental, equine legal and workplace mental-health research. It explains what to ask and compare before choosing a provider, and it does not give professional advice.

Publisher: Professional Resource Library Editorial Desk. The editorial company that writes, edits and publishes Professional Resource Library.
Editorial policy: https://professionalresourcelibrary.com/editorial-standards
Masthead: https://professionalresourcelibrary.com/masthead
Corrections: https://professionalresourcelibrary.com/corrections
Updated: 2026-10-31
